exercises.question: Choose the grammar pattern that matches: "When doing something".

options.text: A とか B とか
A は B ほど～ありません
A は B ほど～ない
Verb るときに

exercises.correctFeedback: Great! Verb るときに matches "When doing something".
exercises.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. The correct pattern is Verb るときに.
exercises.explanation: Used to express the time when an action or event occurs.
